prompt:
Create ONE square game card illustration for 充能火山 (Charging Volcano). Use case: illustration-story. Fresh drawing and distinct shot, opaque full square, no card frame, typography, text, UI, logo or watermark.

REFERENCES: Inputs 1/2/3 are DRAWING STYLE ONLY. Blue-and-gold portrait: broad opaque brush construction, substantial curved hair locks, calm cloth planes; dark-coat portrait: economical dark cloth structure; brown-haired portrait: unmistakably anime face/eyes and selective facial lines. Do not copy their identities, outfits, hats, weapons, text or watermarks. Input 4 is ONLY the character identity reference of Changwuyu; preserve its appearance, not the standing pose, glasses-adjusting hand or background.

CHARACTER: Changwuyu / 常无欲, adult MALE, elegant composed anime face, visible golden-yellow eyes behind THIN round metal-framed eyeglasses, pointed elf ears. Long silver-gray hair gathered into a LOW bun at the back; two substantial long side locks fall over his chest. Black WIDE-BRIM witch hat with a LONG CURVED bent pointed tip and muted purple underside. A black high-neck robe and cape with broad purple lining, subdued gold edges. One white feather plus a blue sapphire in a simple gold mount at his LEFT chest, not on the hat. Black gloved hands. NO staff, wand, sword, military cap or extra jewelry.

DISTINCT COMPOSITION AND ACTION: an intimate, slightly low-angle three-quarter waist-up shot capturing the instant he deliberately CONDENSES power before eruption. Torso slightly turned and leaning in toward the viewer; hat brim makes a strong oblique top shape. Face clear near upper center-left, calm concentrated yellow eyes looking at the molten core, faint confident smile. Both hands in the lower-center foreground surrounding ONE compact orange molten core: lower gloved hand cupped upward, upper gloved hand curved downward above it, separated by a visible gap, as if compressing and containing immense upward pressure. Wrists and fingers naturally connected; TWO hands total, not adjusting glasses. The paired hands make a tense opposing curved bracket, contrasting the poised face. Enlarge the hands slightly through natural perspective but leave all fingers and face readable. Core located away from the face. Cape's large purple inner plane fans outward into a decisive diagonal behind the arms. Keep the bent hat tip and key hands within image margins. Subject dominates the square; unadorned background remains visible.

ABSTRACT BACKGROUND ONLY: large alternating SOLID color fields of pale cool gray, muted smoky plum, and dark aubergine. Clean broad surfaces with decisive irregular handmade boundaries. NO actual volcano, mountain, rocks, crater landscape, sky, clouds, horizon, valley, buildings or scenic environment.
Volcano and magma are SYMBOLS: behind the hands and opposite the face, arrange two or three broad split-chevron dark plum shapes around a rising orange-red tapered slash, suggesting accumulated volcanic pressure through shape alone. These are flat abstract painted motifs rather than a physical mountain or location. At the hands, the single small molten core consists of a quiet warm cream center, broad orange body, and one subdued red outer fold. Two broad tapered vermilion strokes curve INWARD toward the core, suggesting energy being gathered, not an explosion. Fire is opaque symbolic shape with a few purposeful breaks, no literal spray, sparks, droplets, smoke plumes, crack networks or lava environment. Shape hierarchy should make CHARGING obvious: all fire motifs converge into the contained core. Small concentrated heat contrast, not enormous glowing fire covering the character. No rune ring, magic diagram or particle cloud.

PAINTING STYLE: hand-painted anime illustration constructed from large opaque masses and a limited number of BROAD DIRECTIONAL curved or elongated strokes. Confident grouped shadows, decisive handmade edges, selectively broken stroke endings and overlaps surrounded by calm interiors. No uniform flat-fill vector appearance; no coating every surface in texture. Hair consists of substantial coherent silver-gray locks with quiet bases, a few broad blue-gray shadow turns and irregular opaque highlights, no strand networks or pale scratch marks. FACE distinctly anime, clear eyelid shapes and simple golden iris masses with few crisp highlights, clean cheeks, economical nose and mouth, readable hat/fringe cast shadow, under-jaw shadow and neck turn. Selective tapered colored facial marks, no glossy semi-realistic lips or beauty shading. BODY AND CLOTH follow shoulders, elbows, chest and tension with several large connected black/plum planes, a few broad midtone turns and selective crease accents; much of the robe remains quiet. GLOVES: simple readable anatomy with a few gray planes, no leathery photoreal shine. FEATHER: one large tapered white shape with a few grouped notches, sapphire one blue accent and a single highlight. Gold trim matte subdued ochre, no dense shiny engraving.
COLOR: restrained cool gray, near black, dusty plum and violet, localized warm orange/red at the energy core, small yellow eyes and blue chest jewel. Face and hands receive clearest selective drawing; cloth and abstract backdrop simpler. Let a few bold opaque curved paint marks carry motion and force. Avoid cinematic splash art, airbrushed gradients, 3D gloss, photoreal fire, glossy fire-lit materials, tiny faceted chips, triangular mosaics, excessive rim lights, pervasive canvas/noise filters, busy backgrounds, dense decorative marks and evenly traced vector outlines. Match input references' broad painterly anime finish.
